methods.notes: Default firmware: match BTHome-v2 service data UUID 0xFCD2 (bthome-v2) and key on MAC. Legacy firmware: the ESPHome b_parasite component keys on MAC and decodes the custom advertisement.

manufacturer_data.description: Default firmware broadcasts BTHome v2 in BLE SERVICE DATA under UUID 0xFCD2 (see bthome-v2.yaml). Legacy firmware uses a custom advertisement. Devices are keyed by MAC address.

device.name: b-parasite Soil Moisture Sensor
device.notes:
b-parasite is an open-source (nRF52840/nRF52833) BLE soil-moisture sensor that also reports air temperature/humidity, light and battery. Passive BLE listen, no pairing, no cloud. Its DEFAULT firmware broadcasts in BTHome v2 — so decode it per the bthome-v2.yaml reference (service data UUID 0xFCD2). A legacy custom advertisement is also supported (decoded by the ESPHome b_parasite component). Devices are identified by MAC address.
Sensors: SHTC3 (air temp/humidity), a capacitive soil probe (moisture %), and an ALS-PT19 phototransistor (light) on light-equipped boards; CR2032 powered. Licenses: firmware MIT, hardware CC BY-SA 4.0. An experimental Zigbee firmware also exists.

openness.notes: Fully open project. The shipping default is BTHome v2 — cite bthome-v2.yaml for the wire format. The legacy custom format's exact byte offsets are not restated here.

credentials.notes: No pairing/auth (BTHome may be AES-CCM encrypted if built with a key). No Wi-Fi.

factory_reset.effect: Firmware reflash; no broadcast reset. No network/cloud state.

methods.description: Passive: scan for BTHome v2 (UUID 0xFCD2) and decode the object records (soil moisture, temperature, humidity, battery, illuminance). No connection required.

steps.action: Insert the battery; scan for BTHome-v2 service data (UUID 0xFCD2) and decode by MAC.
steps.expect: Soil moisture, air temp/humidity, battery, and light (if fitted) update per advertisement.

setup.notes: Nothing to provision: insert the battery and it broadcasts. Add to Home Assistant via BTHome auto-discovery, or to ESPHome by MAC.

rejoin.notes: No network membership; reading is passive.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The BTHome-v2 default encoding and the measurement set are from the b-parasite BLE sample README and the ESPHome b_parasite component.
